narrative: Today puts a fresh number on the XPU trajectory, and it cuts against the target. Broadcom, the dominant merchant custom-ASIC supplier, guided Q3 AI-chip sales to $16 billion, below the roughly $17.2 billion consensus, and declined to raise its full-year forecast. An in-line print with no raise pressures rather than confirms the climb toward a $20B-per-quarter run-rate.
remaining_gap: No backlog or core-XPU-customer-count disclosure today, and the $16B guide leaves the $20B/quarter run-rate and a seventh named customer unconfirmed.
